tools.name: check_github_bounty
tools.description: Is this public GitHub issue bounty still claimable, or is someone already working on it? Checks current status, reward evidence, competing work, and maintainer signals; returns AVOID, CAUTION, or VIABLE. For 2-7 issues, repeated single checks cost less unless one ranked response is worth the premium

tools.name: rank_github_bounties
tools.description: Which public GitHub bounty should I work on next? Compares 2-10 issue URLs, chooses the strongest non-AVOID candidate or recommends none, and returns cited evidence plus partial failures. It is unit-price economical for 8-10; repeated check_github_bounty calls cost less for 2-7 when ranked orchestra

tools.name: audit_agent_harness
tools.description: Can a coding agent safely work in this public repository without missing project instructions? Audits AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and related instructions at an immutable commit; does not diagnose CI.

tools.name: diagnose_github_actions_run
tools.description: Why did this public GitHub Actions run fail, and what should I fix? Uses bounded failed-job logs and redacted evidence. Use classify_github_actions_flake only for retry-once versus fix.

tools.name: classify_github_actions_flake
tools.description: Is this failed GitHub Actions run flaky—should I retry it once or fix the code? Uses the current attempt and bounded history. Use diagnose_github_actions_run for root cause.

tools.name: check_mcp_tool_drift
tools.description: Will upgrading to this complete MCP tools/list break my agent or weaken declared safety hints? Compares caller-supplied baseline and current snapshots; never fetches or invokes tools.
